title: ゴルシの！いきなり過去編！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Famished after work, I head over to the shopping district to grab a bite to eat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, I find a promising hole-in-the-wall ramen shop. I step inside, only to find a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Welcome! C'mon in!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer! Finished for the day? Good for you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, the ramen broth slumbering in my veins suddenly awoke with a vengeance…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was overcome with a burning desire to craft delicious ramen… so I got myself a part-time gig here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Here, feel free to snack on some appetizers… while I tell you a tale of the past.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …It was a freezing winter day.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was out on the streets, selling metal bats in order to support my folks' screw production factory.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But it was just so cold that day. The bitter chill seeped into my very bones, freezing me to the core.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All I could do was weep all by my lonesome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I swallow the incredulous questions bubbling up about the story's setting and quietly continue listening.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's when an Umamusume appeared before me and changed my life forever.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's right. From what I could tell, she was probably a few years older than me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Without saying a word, she held out a bowl of piping hot ramen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her story seems too outlandish to believe, but Gold Ship keeps talking with utmost sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I thanked her once I thawed out, but she looked at me with a hint of sadness.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: She said, "I'm an Umamusume, but I'm not good at running."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "That's why I want to open my own ramen shop. You should choose the future that's right for you too."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Those words shook my entire world… I mean, until then, nobody'd ever told me I could make my own life decisions.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's when I realized my future wasn't shackled to my family's screw production factory. I could do what was right for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a strange story to wrap my head around, but I still find it touching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing that she shook off the circumstances of her birth to create her own path in life… It's inspiring.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Sorry for talking your ear off.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But you'd get all fired up to make some ramen too if that memory came back to you, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I wonder what that Umamusume is up to now. I'd love to see her again, but I haven't got a clue how to find her…
choice_data_list: Why not try recreating her soup?
How about going back to where you met?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Recreate her soup? I don't even know if I can…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But I can't quit before I try! I've grown up since then, so I bet I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That settles it! If I remember right, it had enough garlic in it to off an elephant!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And… done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's masterpiece is a garlic lover's dream… In fact, there's more garlic in it than noodles and broth combined!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aw yeah, I've nailed it! This garlicky, sinus-obliterating aroma sure takes me back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Here, you can have some too! All right, down the hatch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we taste the freshly made ramen…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It burns! It buuurns! My tongue! It's on fiiiiire!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The garlic is so overwhelming, it's inedible!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh, now that I think of it, garlic's supposed to promote blood flow, right? I guess that's why it warms your body up…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Maybe I only liked it because I was literally frozen that day… Nobody'd want to sit down and eat this normally! Cough!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Gold Ship isn't any closer to tracking down that Umamusume, she sure got one garlicky blast from the past…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, just when I thought I'd forgotten that little episode, something strange happens.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You mean, back to that fateful riverside lane? …Yeah, okay. It's probably worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wow, there's literally not a soul around. Welp, makes sense, considering it's night.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh well. No point in sticking around. Let's call it a day and—huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! Suzuka?! Is that you?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um? Well, yes…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait! Don't tell me you were the Umamusume I met all those years ago!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wh-what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I can't just let you go now that I know who you are! You're comin' with me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eep! What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Don't you go running away from me now! Let's take a stroll down memory lane!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to Gold Ship's story, the Umamusume who saved her was apparently a few years older than her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, even assuming this mystery savior really exists, Silence Suzuka is an unlikely candidate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, just when I thought I'd forgotten that little episode, something strange happens.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I sift through a stack of fan mail, one particular letter catches my eye. I can't help but read it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "It seems you've been living life on your own terms ever since the day we met. I'll continue to watch over you as you forge your own path."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …That's it. There's no name to be found on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Does this mean the Umamusume in Gold Ship's story actually exists?
